about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure—a narrative-driven, point-and-click experience that challenges your observation skills, logic and your wits. As you progress, you’ll search richly detailed locations for cleverly concealed objects and tackle a variety of engaging mini-games and puzzles!

Descend into a realm of mystery where every ripple carries a secret. Velimir—an outcast hunter, desperate to prove his worth—embarks on a mission to find Malena, a young girl who vanished near the eerie shores of the Lake of Tears. Rumors speak of mermaids with lifeless eyes lurking in the depths, but an even older, deadlier power waits below. Venture into a world of ancient magic and hidden creatures as the hunt begins… and discover whether you are the predator or the prey.

Delve into an exciting variety of puzzles, riddles, and mini-games. From classic hidden object hunts to inventive brain teasers, each challenge tests your sharpness of mind and powers of observation.
